body: Lots of pastors and priests will be preaching on the meaning of the crucifixion this week. If you haven’t downloaded or purchased Did God Kill Jesus? yet, this is a great week to do so. Here’s what I wrote in my endorsement: “An extended exploration of one of Christian theology’s oldest, most vexing, intriguing, and important questions… You’ll be grateful for a chance to think alongside a passionate, inspiring theologian who writes with clarity, intensity, and relentless curiosity.”
